findings.title: ShinyHunters Is a Hacking Group on a Data Breach Spree (Wired, first profile of the group)
findings.summary_md: Wired published the first profile of ShinyHunters two weeks after the group surfaced, hawking claimed close to 200 million stolen records from at least 13 companies: 91 million Tokopedia accounts, roughly 22 million Unacademy accounts, and data from Zoosk, Home Chef, Minted, and others, promoted on RaidForums and the Empire dark web market as "Stage 1". Day-level date taken from the article dateline, which shows May 21, 2020 8:00 AM without a timezone.

findings.title: US, French authorities confirm arrest of BreachForums hackers (TechCrunch)
findings.summary_md: Paris prosecutor Laure Beccuau said French police arrested four people suspected of running BreachForums and being part of a collective called ShinyHunters, while the US Justice Department separately indicted British national Kai West (IntelBroker), arrested in France in February. This was the previous arrest wave against the same collective, 15 months before the Dutch arrest in this story.

findings.title: ShinyHunters Wage Broad Corporate Extortion Spree (KrebsOnSecurity)
findings.summary_md: ShinyHunters (tracked by Google as UNC6040) launched the Scattered LAPSUS$ Hunters extortion blog threatening to publish Salesforce data from more than three dozen companies including Toyota, FedEx, Disney/Hulu, and UPS, and claimed breaches of a Red Hat GitLab server holding over 28,000 repositories and of Discord user data. The same post reports KrebsOnSecurity receiving malware-laced threats carrying an ASYNCRAT backdoor. Day-level date; the page shows October 7, 2025 6:45 PM site time without a timezone.

findings.title: Meet Rey, the Admin of 'Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters' (KrebsOnSecurity)
findings.summary_md: KrebsOnSecurity identified Rey, one of three administrators of the Scattered LAPSUS$ Hunters Telegram channel and operator of the ShinySp1d3r ransomware-as-a-service offering, as a 15-year-old from Amman, Jordan, via infostealer data and opsec errors. The post also documents the group's Telegram offers to recruit insider employees at large companies, and the FBI's October 5, 2025 seizure of BreachForums domains. Day-level date; the page shows November 26, 2025 12:22 PM site time without a timezone.
